items.title: PromiseBPP
items.statement_or_definition: A promise pair (Y,N) belongs to PromiseBPP when one fixed worst-case polynomial-time PTM has acceptance probability at least 2/3 on Y and at most 1/3 on N; no condition is imposed outside Y∪N. Random bits are fresh independent fair bits on the finite branch cube.
proof_obligations: State the promised wrapper separately because the root BPP definition is for languages.

items.title: EQP on promise problems
items.statement_or_definition: A promise pair belongs to EQP if a QC14-uniform polynomial-size circuit family has exact acceptance probability 1 on every YES input and 0 on every NO input; off-promise acceptance is unconstrained.
proof_obligations: Use exact finite QC14 gate semantics; do not assume arbitrary real gate entries.

items.title: ZQP on promise problems
items.statement_or_definition: A promise pair belongs to ZQP if a QC14-uniform family outputs a classical label in {YES,NO,?}, never outputs the wrong definite answer on promised inputs, and outputs the correct definite answer with probability at least 2/3. The ? outcome is an allowed failure branch.
proof_obligations: Specify the output partition of the measured output strings and the failure label.

items.title: Indexed uniform circuits convert to full-list polynomial-time generation
items.statement_or_definition: If a polynomial-size Boolean circuit family is generated by a logspace indexed-gate transducer, a deterministic polynomial-time generator can emit its complete self-delimiting gate list: compute the polynomial size bound and query every gate index in order. The emitted family has the same circuit semantics.

A fully explicit exact Toffoli implementation is H on target, then CCZ via the integer phase identity 4abc=a+b+c−(a xor b)−(a xor c)−(b xor c)+(a xor b xor c), then H on target. Apply T to the three individual bits, compute each pair parity into one clean scratch using two CNOTs, apply T† and uncompute, then compute the triple parity with three CNOTs, apply T and uncompute. The scratch is returned to zero, with seven T/T†, eighteen CNOT and two H gates. X=HT⁴H. Hence every bounded-arity Boolean gate has an exact constant-size {H,T,T†,CNOT} clean embedding. A PTM computation has a finite polynomial Boolean DAG; emit its reversible embedding and replace every fixed gate by this list in polynomial generator time.

items.title: Classical randomized Simon decision needs Ω(2^{n/2}) queries
items.statement_or_definition: Under the equal mixture of a uniformly random permutation and a uniformly random valid nonzero-mask 2-to-1 function, any randomized adaptive algorithm with bounded error needs Ω(2^{n/2}) queries. Conditional on no repeated function value, the transcript has the same distribution in both cases; after k−1 distinct answers at most binom(k−1,2) masks have been excluded, so the next collision probability is at most (k−1)/(2^n−1−binom(k−1,2)). Summing to T≤c·2^{n/2} keeps collision probability below a fixed constant, precluding 2/3 distributional success.
proof_obligations: Formalize the adaptive transcript coupling under the two distributions; invoke the fixing argument for randomized algorithms; choose a fixed small c and derive contradiction to 2/3 success.

items.title: Writing an N-bit output costs Ω(N) bit operations

items.title: Adaptive conditional failure budgets compose by union bound

items.title: Tang conditional recommendation sampler

items.title: Symmetric/antisymmetric swap-test measurement
items.statement_or_definition: On two equal-dimensional registers let F(|u>⊗|v>)=|v>⊗|u>. Since F is a self-adjoint involution, P_-=(I−F)/2 and P_+=(I+F)/2 are orthogonal projectors and define a two-outcome measurement; on |ψ>⊗|φ>, the antisymmetric outcome has probability (1−|<ψ|φ>|^2)/2.
proof_obligations: Verify F*=F and F²=I, then compute Tr(P_-(|ψ><ψ|⊗|φ><φ|)) using finite trace cyclicity.

items.title: Simultaneous-message equality by quantum fingerprints
items.statement_or_definition: Input code family E and party strings x,y. Alice and Bob each prepare and send one costed |h_x⟩,|h_y⟩ register. Referee appends c=0, applies H_c, for each corresponding pair of message wires performs controlled-SWAP with control c (using the explicitly defined QC Fredkin gate), applies H_c and measures c. Output unequal iff c=1, equal otherwise. High confidence uses the separate r-pair repetition rule. If the active index dimension is non-dyadic pad with zero amplitudes and swap the entire equal-width registers.
proof_obligations: Expand |0⟩ψφ through H-controlled-SWAP-H to (|0⟩(ψφ+φψ)+|1⟩(ψφ−φψ))/2. This realizes P_± exactly. Charge fingerprint preparation independently from message qubits and two H gates plus one Fredkin per message wire; no shared entanglement/randomness.

items.title: Fingerprint swap-test error and communication cost
items.statement_or_definition: For equal x,y, antisymmetric-outcome probability is zero. For x≠y it is (1−|<h_x|h_y>|²)/2≥[1−(1−δ)²]/2. Repeating with r fresh fingerprint pairs and declaring unequal if any antisymmetric result gives error at most (1−p_0)^r, for supplied fixed δ>0 and N≤Cn with fixed C, r=O(1+log(1/ε)) yields O((1+log n)(1+log(1/ε))) transmitted qubits per party. For arbitrary δ,N instead report r=ceil(log(1/ε)/(−log(1−p_0))) and r(ceil(log₂N)+1) message qubits.
proof_obligations: Derive the symmetric/antisymmetric projectors and swap expectation; calculate both cases and sum independent repetition failure.

A supplied constant-rate, constant-distance code is needed for the asymptotic log n communication statement. Efficient uniform preparation is a separate promise; the nonuniform random-code existence lemma does not give an efficient encoder. For δ=1 the antisymmetric probability remains 1/2, so r finite positive is still charged.
unresolved_obligations: Uniform protocol cost remains conditional on an explicit efficiently generated constant-rate code family; only nonuniform random-code existence is supplied here.

items.title: Random linear-size fingerprint code exists nonuniformly

items.title: Entanglement-free, randomness-free quantum fingerprints require Ω(log n) qubits
items.statement_or_definition: In an SMP protocol with no shared entanglement or randomness, fix Bob input y. The referee’s equality effect separates Alice’s density operator ρ_y from every ρ_x (x≠y) by acceptance gap at least 1/3, so QC06 measurement variation implies pairwise trace distance at least 1/3. Quantize real and imaginary entries of d×d density matrices to mesh Θ(d^{-3/2}); the trace-norm error is below a fixed constant by ||M||_1≤√d||M||_F. At most exp(O(d²log d)) grid cells exist, hence 2^n≤exp(O(d²log d)); with d=2^q this forces q=Ω(log n).
